description: This file contains unit tests for SwiftUI view hierarchy rendering, testing various views within the OpenClaw project using the XCTest framework with custom annotations.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Sets up a UIWindow with the provided SwiftUI view as the root view, making it visible and laying out the view hierarchy.

methods.name: statusPillConnectingBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the view hierarchy creation when a StatusPill with 'connecting' state is rendered.

methods.name: statusPillDisconnectedBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the view hierarchy creation when a StatusPill with 'disconnected' state is rendered.

methods.name: settingsTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the view hierarchy for the SettingsTab view with a configured environment.

methods.name: rootTabsBuildAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the view hierarchy for the RootTabs view with configured environment objects.

methods.name: voiceTabBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the view hierarchy for the VoiceTab view with environment objects.

methods.name: voiceWakeWordsViewBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView inside a NavigationStack.

methods.name: chatSheetBuildsAViewHierarchy
methods.description: Tests the ChatSheet view with environment objects and a GatewayNodeSession.
